summary: Added bounded native PDF extraction through a fixed pdfminer.six 20260107 worker in an operator-configured Linux namespace sandbox. Added public bounded source revision/byte read that checks declared size before blob reads and verifies returned descriptor bytes. Produces provenance blocks with measured geometry and explicit visual-needed page status.
API: pdf_extraction.extract(store, revision_id, PdfRuntime(runtime_dir, packages_dir), PdfPolicy|None), PdfResult, PdfError and PdfPrerequisiteError; OriginalStore.read_verified(revision_id, max_bytes=...). See docs/parallel/pdf-extraction-api.md for exact limits, prerequisites, semantics and caveats.

evidence: Actual tiny PDF native text and pdfminer page bbox compose through owned source store and Registry; deterministic block IDs and policy changes verified. Textless page explicitly partial_visual_needed.

Actual excess pages, object count, text, output and input limits; malformed and encrypted inputs; unsupported media; corrupt and mid-read-mutated source; wrong child identity; missing backend; child crash, timeout, flood, cancellation and selector-startup failure all refuse without returning partial results. Owned child handles were reaped/closed in tests.

Actual namespace probe saw no outside owned canary, home, GPU node, inherited descriptor or writable input, and could not connect to a parent-owned loopback listener. This is a host-specific test, not comprehensive isolation proof.
Import guard blocked model/parser import, network, subprocess and telemetry; module import succeeded without those side effects.
limitations: Local candidate only; no canonical integration, deployment, PR, merge or strategic acceptance.
No project dependency/lock/runtime packaging, license exception or LICENSE-01 clearance. The isolated development graph has unresolved MIT-0, native wheel and notice questions.

Linux x86-64 host-specific bwrap/prlimit and trusted CPython 3.12/package paths require deployment-host qualification; no seccomp policy or hostile-PDF security proof. PDF layout text is heuristic and can synthesize whitespace; native text does not prove all visual content was read.
Wall deadline cannot interrupt blocking filesystem operations. Synthetic fixtures do not qualify real data, GPU, model, vision, full 006, ICA or MVP.
